dropped.t: The information appearing below under Item 4.02(a) refers to certain financial statements that the Company intends to restate.
The Company plans to restate the 2025 Audited Financial Statements and include them in an amendment to the 2025 10-K (the “2025 10-K/A”).

The Company also plans to restate its 2026 Financial Statements and include them in an amendment to each of its Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q for the quarters ended March 31, 2026 (the "Q1 2026 10-Q/A") and June 30, 2026 (the "Q2 2026 10-Q/A").
The Company intends to file the 2025 10-K/A, Q1 2026 10-Q/A, and Q2 2026 10-Q/A with the SEC as soon as reasonably practicable.
An updated report on the effectiveness of the Company's internal control over financial reporting will be included in the 2025 10-K/A.
